excluded_diagnostics.reason: GPU pair was locked by another job before the canary or Harbor launched. Retried the unchanged final snapshot on the released challenge GPU pair; this preflight attempt is not counted as a Harbor run.
Initial observer mistook internal NCCL runtime waits for candidate host waits; correct Oracle was rejected. Excluded from final validation.
Used the same invalid pilot observer; its reward 0 is not evidence for the final fix.
Both semantic scenarios passed, but interleaved rank stdout broke one completion frame. Reports are now serialized outside the observed handoff; all challenge states reran.

superseded_pre_allocation_matrices.reason: Observation initially classified CPU allocation from a CUDA shape as a transfer. Restricted conversions to actual data-moving operations, added a valid pinned-output-buffer alternative and real-CUDA allocation regressions, then reran the complete matrix.

limitations: These are Oracle/control runs, not a new Opus rollout; historical rewards remain unchanged.
Python tensor-operation and explicit host-wait instrumentation is behavioral coverage, not a security boundary against arbitrary native code or fabricated worker reports.
Normal nonblocking output copies and CPU-only metadata work are accepted. Internal NCCL initialization waits and output materialization after sample_tokens are not classified as handoff violations.
